release_notes: Build 109 tidies the normal day-to-day Factburst interface after the archive migration and guided Autopilot work.
Quiz History no longer duplicates Open Publish and Reopen in Quiz Builder in the global header; both actions now live under the local More menu with archive and delete.
The global header is reduced to a simple Refresh action plus a quiet Updates action; when an installed build detects a newer release, the Updates button changes to Update available.
Quiz History renames the YouTube column to Status, uses shorter scheduled-release text, tightens small metric columns and gives more room to YouTube titles and categories.
Long Quiz History titles and category lists now show their full value as a tooltip while remaining neatly ellipsized in the table.
Autopilot Needs You now stays simplified after every status refresh: old per-task manager buttons are removed and Start next task remains the single normal action.
The Autopilot home card now says Keep the schedule filled with a shorter Fill schedule action, separating schedule generation from the guided human-task flow.
When no human action is pending, the Start next task button is hidden and Autopilot clearly says it will continue working in the background.
Build 108 guided Needs You, Build 107 SEO fixes and the completed C to Z archive workflow remain included unchanged.
